title: Questions 168-171 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
Notice to Subscribers

We are contacting you about an upcoming change to our monthly membership rates. As of March 1, the Digital Basic rate will go from $6.49 to $7.49, and the Digital Plus rate will move from $11.49 to $13.49 each month. – [1] –. The All-Access rate will likewise rise from $15.49 to $18.49. – [2] –.

There is, however, some welcome news for loyal members. If you move from monthly billing to yearly billing by February 20, your present rate will be held for a further 12 months. Doing so will spare you the equivalent of almost three months of payments at the new rates. – [3] –. To adjust your billing preferences, open your membership settings page.

Please be aware that the Student Plan will stay where it is at $4.49 per month, since we are determined to keep careful reporting within their reach. – [4] –. Proof of current enrollment at a recognised college is needed to qualify for this option.

Thank you for reading the Harbourline Gazette.
